---
name: A multi-camera dump does not open
about: Another recorder layout, or a luo .dat that misbehaves
labels: format
---

**What recorder or software produced the file?** (brand, model, export tool, year if known)

**What does `python -m multicam_dump info yourfile.dat` print?** (or the error)

**What do you see in other players?** (one camera, noise, nothing)

**A sample.** Only attach a sample you have the right to share. A few MiB cut from the start is enough; remove anything private first.
If you cannot share it, describe the first 64 bytes (hex) and any magic strings you find.
